rules:
This market refers to the FIFA World Cup match between USA (USA) and Bosnia & Herzegovina (BIH), scheduled for 2026-07-02 00:00 UTC.

- USA: If USA wins, the outcome is settled as "Yes"; otherwise "No".

- DRAW: If the match ends in a draw, the outcome is "Yes".

- BIH: If Bosnia & Herzegovina wins, the outcome is "Yes"; otherwise "No".

Settlement will be based on the result at the end of regular time (90 minutes) plus stoppage time.

If the match is postponed, this market will remain open until the match is played and completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, the DRAW option will resolve to "Yes", while both USA and BIH options will resolve to "No".

The primary settlement source will be the official result published by FIFA World Cup.

If the governing body or event organizers have not published the final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus from credible sources may be used instead.

Note: Opinion will resolve strictly based on the first officially published result from the designated source. Any subsequent revisions will not affect this resolution.
Source: https://www.fifa.com/fifaplus/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026

In the upcoming WTA singles match scheduled for 2026-06-29 10:00 UTC: if Xinyu Wang wins the match, this market resolves to "Xinyu Wang"; if Elisabetta Cocciaretto wins, it resolves to "Elisabetta Cocciaretto". The winner is the first player to claim the required number of sets under the match's official best-of format.

If the match begins but is not completed, a retirement or default counts the opposing player as the winner. If a walkover is declared before the first point is played, the match is outright canceled, or it is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50.

Suspensions caused by weather, fading light, or other tournament-imposed delays do not close this market — it stays open until the match is officially completed, provided it concludes within the 7-day window mentioned above.

Resolution Source: The official WTA Tour scoring page.

Note: This market will resolve strictly based on the first officially published result from the designated source. Any subsequent revisions will not affect this resolution.
